assertion_analysis: tests/test_every_attempt_is_supervised.py:153-165: command-line, supervisor-spec, distinct PID, liveness and worker-command assertions fail if resume returns a nonexistent or wrong supervisor, omits its worker, or starts the wrong command.

tests/test_every_attempt_is_supervised.py:161,166-185: fixed expected attempt numbers and absence of an attempt-3 receipt fail when a first resume is misnumbered or the duplicate writer creates another receipt; the canonical-to-immutable equality assertion alone tests consistency, while the fixed numbers supply the independent expectation.

tests/test_every_attempt_is_supervised.py:197-203: either false writer return, canonical attempt 3, or an extra receipt fails the direct duplicate-confirmation check; the restored writer control reaches canonical attempt 3.
tests/test_every_attempt_is_supervised.py:214-219: the raises assertion fails if a dead supervisor without a worker receipt is accepted.

tests/test_every_attempt_is_supervised.py:269-281: running classification, review refusal and SIGKILL receipt assertions fail if a live run is scored or reviewed, or if its worker death is recorded with the wrong signal.

tests/test_every_attempt_is_supervised.py:306-346: command success, fixed attempts 1, 2 and 3, and receipt equality fail if a second resume is refused or misnumbered; the receipt equality alone could move with the canonical record, so fixed attempt constants carry the numbering guard.
tests/test_every_attempt_is_supervised.py:465-467: fixed lane-change attempt, kind and destination assertions fail if redispatch omits or mislabels its new attempt.
